hypothesis: A bounded observational expression search, goal-directed constructors and generic lifting of learned functions into Fold can acquire keyed state transitions and batch grouping without adding a group-by, dictionary, read/write or other VM opcode.
provided: bounded observational equivalence as a search heuristic, not proof
generic map and state-transition Fold lifting
source_tasks: update keyed state from one event
construct a unit-valued record from a scalar symbol
development_targets: batch keyed totals, in last-update order
weighted totals by key via learned composition
symbol histogram via the same grouping mechanism
controls: frozen v15 on the same compiled source seed and new target demonstrations
required_checks: public scalar invocation has the same admitted input contract as its program
independent admission and counterexamples survive observational deduplication
grouped totals on unseen keys, signs, empty lists and new lengths
same grouping reused for a different input family
captured-call dependencies and isolated numeric birth preserved
no new opcode or target-named dispatch
all search attempts charged and bounded
real telemetry and previous regression suites
scope: Declared development tasks, not a new independent full M0 reserve. A useful grouping demonstration does not by itself approve all M0 gates or M1-M10. Learned transitions are prior knowledge for batch tasks, not learning grouping from no prior.
